punchline: At MyFitnessPal the cure for misaligned goals was a meeting where every department head named the teams they depended on.
thirty_sec: In Doerr's MyFitnessPal chapter, co-founder Mike Lee found that many OKRs did not line up and that teams were stuck waiting on other teams. The fix was a regular meeting where department heads presented their OKRs and named the teams they depended on. At Intuit, Atticus Tysen says the key was making all OKRs visible to everyone.
